title: Inventory: Ehrenreich et al. 2012 (PLOS Genetics 8:e1002570) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/ehrenreich2012/raw/`: the 17 supporting-information files
of doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1002570, downloaded one by one from journals.plos.org
`journal.pgen.1002570.sNNN.<ext>`, the extension set from the file type (PLOS sends no file name).
The article page is kept as `sources/ehrenreich2012/article.html`; roles below quote its captions.

roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s001.doc: Figure S1: plots of X-QTL mapping results per trait (MATalpha minus MATa probe difference, selection minus controls). Figure only.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s002.doc: Figure S2: cloning of HXT6 and RED1 (allele replacements). Figure only.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s003.doc: Figure S3: likelihood surface for the singleton/doubleton ratio and detection rate. Figure only.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s004.xlsx: File S1: dose-response experiments with segregant pools, and the cross-specific drug doses used in the X-QTL selections. Ingested: the dose table (traits.cond) and both sheets kept verbatim in docs/v/e12_extra.json.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s005.txt: File S2: processed log10 hybridization intensities, BYxRM cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/ (6 MB).
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s006.txt: File S3: processed log10 hybridization intensities, BYxYJM cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s007.txt: File S4: processed log10 hybridization intensities, BYxYPS cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s008.txt: File S5: processed log10 hybridization intensities, RMxYJM cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s009.txt: File S6: processed log10 hybridization intensities, RMxYPS cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s010.txt: File S7: processed log10 hybridization intensities, YJMxYPS cross. Checksummed here, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s011.txt: File S8: the authors' peak caller (R). Read to settle column semantics; not a table.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s012.txt: File S9: function library for the peak caller (R): Savitzky-Golay smoothing, quantile thresholds, peak grouping. Not a table.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s013.txt: File S10: loci detected in the X-QTL experiments. Core input: 411 distinct loci, with detection and direction in each of the 6 crosses.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s014.txt: File S11: candidate genes for bi-allelic loci (the 135 allelic-singleton loci; genes with nonsynonymous SNPs in the singleton pattern). Ingested as candidate-gene rows.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s015.doc: Table S1: patterns used to identify allelic singletons and doubletons, with counts. The table is an embedded image (no text); its legible totals are checked in tests/test_ehrenreich2012.py.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s016.doc: Table S2: allelic series inferred from the data. Embedded image; not ingested.
roles.journal.pgen.1002570.s017.doc: Text S1: formulae for the detection rate and the singleton/doubleton ratio. Not a table.

missing: No interval, LOD score or effect size for any locus: File S10 gives one position per grouped locus and, per cross, whether a peak was detected and its direction. The peak caller (File S8/S9) calls peaks on smoothed probe differences at a 1% FDR and never computes an interval.
No per-cross peak positions: only the grouped locus position is given, so the 837 per-cross peaks of the text cannot be placed individually.
No statement of the S288C reference release used for array design ("the BY genome sequence obtained from the Saccharomyces Genome Database"); see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md (Ehrenreich 2012 section).
Tables S1 and S2 are pictures inside Word files, not data.
